risk_dispositions.implementation: Epoch-vector cursors freeze rank keys, filters, version IDs and candidate page spans. Current removals shorten pages after selection; they cannot backfill across cached pages or reweave recommendations.
Store one current row plus actual changes, shared across queries. Retain retired rows for cursor TTL plus margin; bounded cleanup.
Indexed per-partition LIMIT, bounded global merge, SQL/monotonic work deadlines including collection inserts; explicit retry on exhaustion.
Complete small eligible set or uniform dense-slot rejection; no nearest-UUID or top-N bias; explicit 503 after4096 trials.
Transactional triggers cover source writers. Pending flags survive late lower-sequence commits; idempotent pair ledger, bounded backfill/source audit and explicit counter repair.
Pair last_at is event-time maximum. Expiry reads the latest durable row under its partition lock; replay/refresh cannot decrement an obsolete timer.
Sixteen independently locked partitions, bounded batches and 60s rank coalescing. Main race transaction only appends receipts. Busy-partition scheduling removes sixteen-way empty polling.

Current hide, account, block and revision-state checks before delivery. Frozen bounded block collections change new-view identity immediately after block/unblock. Actor-bound HMAC cursors, scoped caches, deletion fences and bounded erasure.
At most13 payload pages/260 cards plus nearby placeholders; rebase scroll and grid columns, reload prior cursors, exact revision anchors, busy/expiry retry states.
Initial local favourites/raced IDs become typed indexed expiring collection members; later pages send only a cursor. Device-local semantics remain.
Three-official/one-community two-stream phase, explicit unique tie keys, rated/unrated boolean seek, 18-decimal integer score, expanded Unicode keys and BIGINT rating sum.

Explicit v3 contract and scoped disk namespace. V2 always426, no overload fallback. Independent supervised process, backfill readiness/freshness gates, full connection budget and coordinated-release runbook.
Actual SQLite/PostgreSQL/native correctness, million-track read plans/buffers and timed pages, sparse Random and hot receipt/pair/WAL probe; remaining capacity dimensions are explicit.

known_baseline_failure.finding: Old fixture overrides App._ready without constructing root_ui, then calls the newer publication-confirmation path. Null add_child in App._own_dialog3466 reproduces with task-original Cloud.
known_baseline_failure.disposition: Preserved assertions and current App. V3 exact publication-revision handoff is independently covered by the new native test.

remaining_acceptance: Backup and representative-copy migration timing: widening existing rating_sum can rewrite/lock track_versions. New projection indexes start empty; index/WAL/disk and rollback backup need release capacity.

Apply0050 and all matching current migrations, deploy matching API/supervisor/worker and client, let source/backfill catch up, inspect logged partition lag and canary before traffic. No live rollout performed.
No generic sublinear guarantee for arbitrary combinations/short substrings. Budget exhaustion is a retry response, and selective Random may also retry.

Measure production concurrent p95/p99, API/worker peak RSS, database connection saturation, skew, WAL/vacuum/cleanup, backlog and failure recovery. The local burst excludes daemon sleeps and verification/HTTP.

Measure large recent-pair and changed-history populations separately. Catalogues, accounts, active sessions, revisions and seven-day distinct pairs are independent dimensions;500million accounts and140million pairs were not instantiated.

Bounded metadata audit sweeps128 tracks/partition/minute, so complete reconciliation time grows with catalogue size. Journal is the normal freshness authority; explicit derived-counter repair may need offline time for huge ledgers.
Future ranking/collation/protocol changes require a new compatible version or expiry/drain policy. No permanent old-client whole-catalogue fallback.
Owner workflow and physical-device acceptance remain; no phone attachment check, phone test or APK action.
